title: Seerr links and library counts
summary: Open matching items in Jellyfin from request details, with fixes for request deletion and library counts.
highlights: On open dashboards, anyone who can reach Jellydash can manage Seerr requests by default. A saved opt-out stays in effect. To make the queue view-only, turn off Allow management on this open dashboard under Settings > Seerr.
Request details show Open in Jellyfin when Jellydash verifies the library match. Jellyfin checks your access when you follow the link.
Request details close after a successful Delete request. The library files stay in place. File removal still requires a separate opt-in.
Libraries leaves virtual episode placeholders out of its episode and total file counts.
